_comment: src/assets/objects/salt_pan.png を作り直すためのレシピ。build.py が読む。
平たい石4つを並べて底を張った、海水を日に干す浅い盤（src/assets/world-codex/salt.yaml）。
**配置を描いて渡す（sketch: salt_pan）。** 生成では盤の形までは出るが、材質が白い漆喰の箱に
なる（4枚とも。prompts/objects.json の salt_pan 参照）——白い物は紙と同じ明るさなので
card_art.py の「紙より暗ければ物」に掛からない。
**張った海水も採れた塩も描かない**（どちらも枠と数の中身。薪棚と同じ）。残るのは石と、縁に
**塩の跡を白で塗らせない。** 石より明るくすると縁が切り出しで食われる。編集の指示でも
「石より明るくしない」と言う。
**tolerance は 16**（他の設備の24より低い）。盤の床は乾いた砂で、紙との差がいちばん小さい。
段は400。炉・燻し小屋と同じ据え置きの設備。

edit.prompt: Redraw this flat diagram as a soft hand painted illustration on a plain empty white page, keeping the same layout and the same sizes: one shallow salt pan set on the ground, four flat slabs of grey stone laid edge to edge in a square to make one low rim, with a floor of packed damp sand inside them. Paint the slabs as real stone, mottled mid grey with soft brush strokes and gentle shading, each slab clearly separate from the next so that four of them can be counted, and paint the floor inside as damp grey brown sand. Everything is clearly darker than the white page. Along the inner edges of the slabs leave a thin crust of dried salt, dull grey and never brighter than the stone beside it. The pan is empty: there is no water, no pool, no puddle, no reflection, no shine and no heap of salt anywhere in the picture, and it is not a basin of pottery, not a tray and not a bath. Keep the plain empty white page with a wide white margin all around, and put one soft grey shadow along the foot of the pan. Dry matte surface, flat even lighting. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signature.
